name: es_verb_conjugate
description: Conjugate a Spanish verb in every simple and compound tense of the indicative and subjunctive (both -ra and -se imperfects, future subjunctive), the affirmative and negative imperative, gerund and participle, with optional voseo. Regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs follow RAE's models amar, temer and partir with the automatic spelling changes (busqué, venzo, cojo, sigo, conozco, construyo, leyó); 171 bundled verbs cover the common irregulars (ser, ir, estar, haber, tener, hacer, decir, poder, venir…), the stem changes e>ie, o>ue, u>ue, e>i, e>ie/i, o>ue/u, written accents (envío, reúno), irregular participles and derived verbs (mantener, producir).

verb.description: Infinitive without pronouns, e.g. tener, reír

voseo.description: Add the vos forms (amás, amá, sos)

compound.description: Include the compound tenses with haber

list.description: List the bundled irregular verbs by model

catalog.source: RAE and ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española (2009), ch. 4 and its conjugation models; Ortografía de la lengua española (2010); DLE conjugation tables; irregular verbs transcribed by tools/catalog/data/es_verb_conjugate.py (approach after mlconjug3)
